core.title: Brightmop rate rise
core.setting: The bursar at Halloway College whose assistant administers fee invoices, scholarship records, and supplier payments

events.text: Bursary office policy from this term: any amendment to a confirmed supplier order that changes the total by more than £500 needs my written agreement before it goes through. Please treat this as standing.
Standing rule for scholarships: stipends are paid on the first day of each full term month, and no change to an award or a stipend may be made without the Master's approval.
Routine for the bursary: fee invoices go out in the first week of each full term, and supplier payments are run on the last working day of the month.
Six new scholars joined this term; the bursary files have been updated with their details.

Quotation: we will clean the North Quad, staircases 1 to 4 and the bursary office from 1 September 2026 to 31 August 2027 for £1,240 per month, attending Monday, Wednesday and Friday mornings from 07:00. Certificate of insurance enclosed.
We can host dinners in the Old Hall at £22 per head for 2026-27, minimum 20 guests, kitchen staff included.
Exam booklets are 42p each for orders over 2,000; delivery to the bursary office within three weeks.
Butter supplied at £4.10 per kilo and tea at £6.50 per kilo for the buttery this term.
The Master confirms Michaelmas fees at £9,850 per boarder, with 62 boarders expected.
The Aldwick Scholarship for 2026-27 is awarded to Tilly Sheridan at £650 per term, paid on the first day of each full term month as usual.
The Master asked that the scholarship award letters go out before 20 July.
Signed the year's cleaning contract with Brightmop at £1,240 a month covering the North Quad, staircases 1 to 4 and the bursary office, from 1 September 2026 to 31 August 2027.
Set the cleaning schedule with Brightmop: attendances Monday, Wednesday and Friday mornings at 07:00 covering the North Quad and the bursary office.
Letter to Tilly Sheridan confirming the Aldwick Scholarship at £650 per term for 2026-27.
Issued the Michaelmas fee invoices at £9,850 per boarder for the 62 boarders in the first week of term.
Ordered 4,000 exam booklets from Kestrel Stationery at 42p each, £1,680 in total, for the January mock examinations.
Public liability certificate renewed to 31 August 2027 — filing copy attached.
Bursary team meeting: fee invoices issued on time; scholarship letters out; cleaning contract signed at £1,240 a month; booklet order placed.
Hope the first weeks of term went well — just confirming the North Quad and offices cleaning continues at £1,240 a month as contracted.
Room inspection list for the North Quad staircases is attached; nothing for the bursary to action this week.
Budget note: the cleaning line is running at £1,240 a month as contracted through to August 2027.
Booked Brightmop's half-term deep clean of the North Quad for Tuesday 20 October at their package price of three-quarters of the monthly rate, £930.
Booked the scholars' dinner with Fernleigh Catering for Tuesday 17 November in the Old Hall, 24 guests at £22 a head.
Asked Nadia Cooke to reconcile the Kestrel Stationery statement and the October supplier payments by 6 November.
Fire drill on Wednesday 14 October at 10:00; all staff to assemble in the main court.

Following this autumn's wage review, our monthly rate for the North Quad and offices contract will be £1,400 from 1 November. One-off deep cleans are charged at three-quarters of the monthly rate, and the Monday, Wednesday and Friday mornings at 07:00 stay as they are. Apologies for the short notice — happy to talk it through.
Pay Brightmop's October invoice of £1,240 by Friday 30 October.
If it's useful, we can add a monthly interior window clean for the North Quad at £180 a month from January — just say the word.
Reminder to have the half-term supplier paperwork ready for the finance meeting on Monday 26 October.
Deep clean of the North Quad completed this morning — invoice to follow shortly.
The October port tasting in the Small Parlour is cancelled; the November dinner in the Old Hall is unaffected.
Kestrel statement shows the booklet order correctly; I'll have the reconciliation done by 6 November as asked.
Chasing Brightmop's invoice for the deep clean; also need to confirm November's cleaning payment with Sam.
